text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap stares intently at a bag of snack food
with a troubled expression on her face.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh... Maybe just one...
But, my skin breakouts...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: "...When I consulted Creek about my rough skin,she told me it's best to cut back on greasy food."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Still, now that the sweets are right in front of me—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... Guess I'll pass on the carrot snacks
and settle for spinach cookies instead...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unable to eat her favorite foods due to her rough skin,
Oguri Cap seemed somewhat down in the dumps.
